market_pulse.narrative: A wave of new licensing, penalties, and regulatory frameworks is being introduced across Africa and Asia, including Rwanda licences, Kenya payout penalties, Mozambique SMS ad rules, Thailand AI‑deepfake crackdown, and Canadian provincial launches. These changes reshape market entry strategies and compliance requirements.

market_pulse.theme: Growth and scrutiny of prediction markets
market_pulse.narrative: Prediction markets are gaining mainstream attention, with tribal gaming groups lobbying in Washington, Love Island driving new betting audiences, and major operators like DraftKings seeing valuation adjustments. Executive exits at Crypto.com highlight the sector’s volatility.

Several high‑profile appointments and departures are reshaping the industry’s leadership landscape, from ZEAL’s VP move to SevenCanyon, Aristocrat’s new COO, to BetConstruct AI’s CEO appointment and Crypto.com’s prediction‑markets chief exit.
Operators and NGOs are launching advisory committees, anonymity‑focused tools, and CPD‑accredited learning to strengthen responsible‑gambling frameworks and address stigma around problem gambling.

market_pulse.theme: Regulation of prediction markets and gambling platforms
market_pulse.narrative: European regulators are tightening rules on prediction markets and related platforms, with ISP blocking in the Czech Republic, licensing scrutiny in France and Ireland, and a German ban on ADI PredictStreet, signalling a broader crackdown on crypto‑based and decentralized betting services.
